mutants.description: write accepts a handle whose badge is not the surface owner's
mutants.witness:
def wc1 : CompositorState := ⟨4, [⟨1, 0, 4, true⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_foreign_badge : ¬ type_of% @write_handle_validity := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, ho, _⟩ := h wc1 ⟨0, 2⟩ 0 5 rfl
  simp [wc1] at hs
  subst hs
  simp at ho

mutants.old: else if s.writable = false then (.roTrap, c)

theorem witness_readonly_write : ¬ type_of% @write_handle_validity := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _, hw⟩ := h wc2 ⟨0, 1⟩ 0 5 rfl

mutants.description: write omits the framebuffer bound: the same cells change on reachable states, but the status differs (BOUNDS becomes SURFACE_CONFLICT)
mutants.old: else if c.width ≤ x then (.bounds, c)
mutants.witness:
def wc3 : CompositorState := ⟨2, [⟨1, 0, 4, true⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_past_frame : ¬ type_of% @write_physical_confinement := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h wc3 ⟨0, 1⟩ 3 5 rfl
  revert h0
  decide

theorem witness_outside_surface : ¬ type_of% @write_spatial_confinement := by
  intro h

mutants.description: write omits the check against other owners' writable surfaces: equivalent on reachable states, given Isolated (status and effect)
mutants.witness:
def wc5 : CompositorState := ⟨4, [⟨1, 0, 4, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, 4, true⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_shared_cell : ¬ type_of% @write_isolation := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h wc5 ⟨0, 1⟩ 0 5 rfl ⟨2, 0, 4, true⟩ (by simp [wc5]) rfl rfl
  simp at h0

mutants.description: write stores the value one cell to the right
mutants.old: framebuffer := fun i => if i = x then v else c.framebuffer i
mutants.new: framebuffer := fun i => if i = x + 1 then v else c.framebuffer i
mutants.witness:
def wc6 : CompositorState := ⟨4, [⟨1, 0, 4, true⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_wrong_cell : ¬ type_of% @write_effect := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h wc6 ⟨0, 1⟩ 0 5 1 (by decide)
  exact absurd h0.1 (by decide)

mutants.description: a read-only write is refused with BAD_SURFACE instead of RO_TRAP
mutants.old: else if s.writable = false then (.roTrap, c)
mutants.new: else if s.writable = false then (.badSurface, c)

mutants.description: registration admits overlapping writable surfaces of distinct owners
mutants.old: else if c.surfaces.any (fun o => s.conflicts o) then (.surfaceConflict, c)
mutants.witness:
def wr1 : CompositorState := ⟨4, [⟨1, 0, 2, true⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_overlap_admitted : ¬ type_of% @register_preserves_isolated := by
  intro h
  have hi : wr1.Isolated := by
    unfold CompositorState.Isolated
    intro a ha b hb
    simp [wr1] at ha hb
    subst ha
    subst hb
    decide
  have h0 := h wr1 ⟨2, 1, 2, true⟩ hi ⟨1, 0, 2, true⟩ (by decide) ⟨2, 1, 2, true⟩ (by decide)
  revert h0
  decide

mutants.description: registration admits a surface extending past the framebuffer
mutants.old: else if c.width < s.xStart + s.xLen then (.bounds, c)
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_surface_past_frame : ¬ type_of% @register_preserves_inframe := by
  intro h
  have hf : (CompositorState.init 4).InFrame := by
    unfold CompositorState.InFrame
    intro t ht
    simp [CompositorState.init] at ht
  have h0 := h (CompositorState.init 4) ⟨1, 3, 4, true⟩ hf ⟨1, 3, 4, true⟩ (by decide)
  revert h0
  decide

mutants.old: else if maxSurfaces ≤ c.surfaces.length then (.noSlots, c)
mutants.witness:
def wr3 : CompositorState := ⟨100, (List.range 16).map (fun i => ⟨1, i, 1, true⟩), fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_seventeenth : ¬ type_of% @register_preserves_bounded := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h wr3 ⟨1, 16, 1, true⟩ (by unfold CompositorState.Bounded; decide)
  revert h0
  unfold CompositorState.Bounded
  decide

mutants.description: registration refuses every overlap, as the original model did (over-strict)
mutants.old: a.writable && b.writable && a.ownerBadge != b.ownerBadge && a.overlaps b
mutants.witness:
def wr4 : CompositorState := ⟨4, [⟨1, 0, 2, false⟩], fun _ => 0⟩
theorem witness_permitted_overlap_refused : ¬ type_of% @register_ok_iff := by
  intro h
  have hrhs := (h wr4 ⟨2, 0, 2, true⟩).mpr ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, ?_, by decide⟩
  · revert hrhs
    decide
  · intro o ho _ how
    simp [wr4] at ho
    subst ho
    simp at how
